prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a person’s hand pointing at a colorful infographic on a digital screen or printed page. The infographic is a circular pie chart illustrating the world production of Atlantic Salmon, with a simple line drawing of a fish in the center. The chart is divided into several colored segments, each representing a different country’s share, with Norway’s segment being the largest and highlighted in dark blue. To the left of the chart, a text box states, “Norway has maintained its position as the leading producer of Atlantic Salmon globally.” Additional country names and percentages are partially visible on the right. The lighting is soft and natural, with gentle reflections and a shallow depth of field that blurs the background, focusing attention on the finger and the chart. The overall color palette is cool and professional, dominated by blues, whites, and muted accent colors, evoking a clean, modern, and informative atmosphere suitable for a documentary or educational presentation. The camera angle is slightly tilted, adding a dynamic, in-the-moment feel to the composition.
